### Why DO NOT SHIP
Two of the five defects (#1 total-price bug, #2 tier-not-saved bug) sit directly in the purchase/registration path and would misquote or misrecord real transactions — that alone is disqualifying for a release candidate. The other three (#3 diagnostics, #4 promo validation, #5 dead Export button) are lower severity but still indicate the build wasn't smoke-tested end-to-end before being cut as a candidate."
